Comment: Unique dialog between multiple Party Members if costume is equipped. This dialog can be accessed via the Sub Menu in dungeons. The format listed will be (Party Member) and (Party Member). The first Party Member listed must be in the party and have the costume equipped. The second Party Member listed must also be in the party (Rise is always in the party), but can be wearing any costume. Sometimes you may need to talk to said Party Member twice to get the unique dialog.
Available: First day costume can be obtained
Requirements: Any additional requirements to obtain costume

blocks.text: Four costumes are obtained by petting the Fox when he is happy. This works on a set schedule of Happy to Neutral to Angry. In addition to this, these four costumes have the following requirements:
Kung Fu Costume: Pet the fox once beforehand, regardless of mood. Earliest day to pet the Fox is May 6th, making the first day to obtain this costume May 22nd.
Kingpin Duster: Available starting on June 21st after first obtaining the Kung Fu Costume.
Lord Flauntleroy: Available starting on July 12th after first obtaining the Kung Fu Costume and Kingpin Duster.
Track Suit: Available starting on August 27th after first obtaining the Kung Fu Costume, Kingpin Duster, and Lord Flauntleroy.
